### Chorus
Chr: Wa Emimimo jowo wagbe wawo fun walagbara Emimimo/fun walagbara emi

### Verse 1
| Emimimo gbe wawo gbe wawo baba/2 ninu orinwa o baba dakun tunide. kojaide  niunorin wao baba jekarianu gba Emimimo (gbe wawo)2 baba o atide.

### Verse 2
| Bina bawole okunkun aparada Emi oruno wole aferio kotunide kojaide kowawo alaisan san niti pentecost ti lojosi lyeniyaraoke. Emimimo ( gbe wawo) lonio baba

### Verse 3
| Olorun aye-agbara lawayi ijoba orunda fagbarawo alagbara lole gbaa femi Orun bewawo kaledalagbara ninure
